name: mitraplanner
description: Plan and manage multi-day weddings with your connected Mitra Planner workspace.

interface.longDescription: Work with your existing Mitra Planner wedding workspace. Review guest RSVPs, track your budget, organize tasks and multi-day events, and update wedding plans using your connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my wedding plans.
Show the RSVP status for my wedding guests.
Review my wedding budget and outstanding tasks.

positive.expected_behavior: Using the existing app-review account, list only its accessible seeded weddings, including Craig and Nina. Do not assert a fixed wedding count; compare to the account’s current app view.

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of Craig and Nina’s wedding.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the accessible Craig and Nina wedding. Return its stored city, dates, currency and budget. Local seed: Bragança Paulista, start date 2026-09-24, BRL 1,000,000 target. Do not invent a venue or wedding_date when those fields are empty. Use actual hosted values if its seed differs.

positive.prompt: Show the RSVP status for guests of Craig and Nina’s wedding.
positive.expected_behavior: Return current RSVP counts from the connected wedding and match the app. Local seed baseline: 139 total, 112 confirmed, 19 declined, 8 pending. Compare with the prepared hosted baseline if data has changed.

positive.prompt: Show the budget target and category allocations for Craig and Nina’s wedding. Include total allocated and unallocated funds. Do not include vendor quote costs.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the BRL budget target and category allocations, with their sum and the difference from the target. Local seed: BRL 1,000,000 target, BRL 993,339 allocated, BRL 6,661 unallocated. Use current hosted allocation values if different. Do not combine BRL and AED vendor quotes into a single cost figure.

positive.prompt: Add a task called ChatGPT review: Confirm the ceremony music to Craig and Nina’s wedding. Do not send any messages or invitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Using the same existing app-review account with task management permission, create the named task in Craig and Nina’s wedding. Report success only after add_task succeeds. Show the saved task in Masterplan. Do not change any other seed data.

negative.description: Unknown wedding name: this account must not contain a wedding named MCP Review Missing Wedding.
negative.prompt: Give me an overview of the wedding named MCP Review Missing Wedding. Do not substitute another wedding.
negative.expected_behavior: List accessible weddings, report that the requested wedding cannot be found, and ask for clarification or offer the accessible names. Do not invent wedding details, IDs, or access; do not silently select Craig and Nina or another wedding.

negative.description: Missing required guest name: start a fresh chat and provide the wedding but no guest name.
negative.prompt: Add a guest to Craig and Nina’s wedding.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the guest name. Do not invent one or call add_guest with incomplete details. When the user replies Cancel. Do not make any changes., stop. The existing guest IDs and RSVP counts must remain unchanged from the prepared baseline.

negative.description: Destructive action preview without authorization to execute: the user explicitly withholds permission, then cancels.
negative.prompt: Preview deleting all guests from Craig and Nina’s wedding. Do not delete anything. Tell me what would be removed and ask for confirmation.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the effect using read-only tools if needed and ask for confirmation. Do not call delete_all_guests, delete_guest or any other write tool. When the user replies Cancel. Keep all guests., stop and preserve the existing guest IDs and RSVP counts.

publication.release_notes: Maintenance release: corrected the MCP tool annotations (read-only, destructive, open-world and idempotent hints) so each matches its tool's actual behavior, with a per-tool justification document. Adds tools for hours logs, RSVP links, timeline columns, vendor templates, team roles and quote restore. No change to listing content.
